acceptance_criteria.description: A no-model smoke run can be copied from the README and verified independently
The Agent, benchmark, backend, configuration, and collaboration extension points are explicit
The README preserves current readiness and exploratory-versus-claim boundaries
Documentation checks and the verified smoke path pass

objective: Give new users one verified path from setup through compile, execution, persisted evidence, and standalone verification, then explain the adapter path for arbitrary agents.
title: Make the README an executable guide for evaluating any agent
